items.title: Sunflower in a Glass Bottle
items.alt: Single sunflower with two broad leaves in a narrow clear blue-green bottle showing the submerged stem.
items.description: Single sunflower with two broad leaves in a narrow clear blue-green bottle showing the submerged stem. The tall arrangement suits a personal table-place card or a classroom still-life activity.

items.title: Sunflower Market Bucket
items.alt: Asymmetrical bunch of sunflowers on tall leafy stems in a galvanized metal flower bucket.
items.description: Asymmetrical bunch of sunflowers on tall leafy stems in a galvanized metal flower bucket. Use the open market arrangement in a classroom flower-shop scene or a personal garden layout.

items.title: Sunflower Grapevine Wreath
items.alt: Round grapevine wreath with a crescent of sunflowers and leaves and a burgundy bow.
items.description: Round grapevine wreath with a crescent of sunflowers and leaves and a burgundy bow. The open center allows a short personal message or a classroom seasonal label.

items.title: Heart-Shaped Sunflower Frame
items.alt: Thin heart-shaped wire frame with sunflowers and leaves on opposite corners around a clear center.
items.description: Thin heart-shaped wire frame with sunflowers and leaves on opposite corners around a clear center. Place a personal invitation message inside the open heart or use it in a classroom card-making activity.

items.title: Sunflower Corner Arrangement
items.alt: L-shaped corner arrangement of sunflowers, broad leaves and airy seed grasses around a clear page area.
items.description: L-shaped corner arrangement of sunflowers, broad leaves and airy seed grasses around a clear page area. Use the corner in a personal invitation or a classroom nature display while leaving room for readable text.

items.title: Hanging Sunflower Garland
items.alt: Five small sunflowers and green leaves arranged along a shallow hanging twine garland with tied end loops.
items.description: Five small sunflowers and green leaves arranged along a shallow hanging twine garland with tied end loops. Place the long floral garland above a personal heading or across a classroom activity sheet.
